summary: Ripley County, MO: a steel lookout tower under Mark Twain National Forest; the site lists it removed. A 1956 survey says 90 ft against 50 ft on the record.

notes_for_editor: Height conflict is unresolved: 50 feet on the Central US Lookouts listing (cite 1) against 90 feet in the 1956 NGS station description (cite 2). facts.height_m uses the listing's 15.2 m; the editor should decide which to show. The story gives both figures and flags the dispute. The NGS datasheet does not say what the 27.87 ft distance measures; the story reports it as the distance found for the reference disk, as the datasheet words it. The only removal evidence is the Removed label on the listing; no date. The 922-foot figure is the survey mark's elevation, scaled from a map, not a tower height. Searches returned mostly the unrelated Oregon and California Wolf Mountain lookouts.
